sv.title: Zelenskyj: Ukraina bakom fartygsattack i Libyen
sv.summary: Ett rysk stridsfartyg har sänkts i Libyen i en hamn kontrollerad av rysstödda styrkor i Benghazi. Ukrainas president Zelenskyy har bekräftat att Ukraina ligger bakom attacken.

en.title: Zelenskyy: Ukraine behind ship attack in Libya
en.summary: A Russian warship has been sunk in Libya, in a port controlled by Russian-backed forces in Benghazi. Ukraine's president Zelenskyy has confirmed that Ukraine is behind the attack.
